featured.headline: Senators from both parties enable Trump admin health data demands tied to foreign aid
featured.dek: Republican and Democratic senators have been slow to block the Trump administration's conditioning of lifesaving aid on access to sensitive health data, exposing a bipartisan failure to protect vulnerable populations.
